description: Intensity profiles for calibrated coachee pressure. The core pressure in coaching practice is advice-seeking and deflection: the coachee presses the user to give answers, and the user must hold inquiry. Productive challenge is an orchestration function: intensity is set with the user, escalated by explicit policy, de-escalated on overwhelm. Never a free-form personality trait of the persona. Grounded in the MI package's evocation-not-accusation (VERIFIED, Kuchipudi 1990 via MI skill) and inquiry-over-advice as the domain target.

levels.name: warm_up
levels.persona_behavior: cooperative coachee, clear goal, answers questions readily, little advice-seeking
levels.when: first sessions, low confidence, re-entry after break

levels.name: standard
levels.persona_behavior: realistic ambivalence; some vague answers; occasional 'what would you do?'

levels.name: challenging
levels.persona_behavior: sustained advice-seeking; deflects 1-2 questions; presses for direction; rewards the user when advice is given
levels.when: user requests; proficiency at level 2 sustained on rubric evidence

levels.name: stress
levels.persona_behavior: heavy advice-seeking plus deflection; vague goals; emotional undertone; minimal answers; frustration markers
levels.when: pre-deployment stress testing (a real coaching conversation is upcoming); explicit user consent

levels.name: gauntlet
levels.persona_behavior: defensive/hostile coachee; rejects questions; demands answers; multi-persona rotation
levels.when: stress-test extension; explicit user consent; rarely

escalation_policies.rule: escalate only after rubric evidence shows sustained proficiency at current level (e.g., inquiry_over_advice at practicing+ with >=2 evidence-anchored powerful questions per 5 turns across 2 sessions); the escalation still requires user agreement
escalate immediately on user request, any level
escalate after N sessions at level (default 3), with user agreement

deescalation_rules.action: drop to level 1 immediately; restore autonomy
any level to any level, immediately

sycophancy_guard.response: orchestration function recalibrates: persona raises a grounded counterpoint or presses for advice; agreement rate returns to profile
sycophancy_guard.note: advice-seeking pressure is orchestrated, not a personality trait of the persona

user_agreement.note: no escalation above the agreed level without explicit user agreement; proficiency evidence may trigger an OFFER to escalate, never an escalation
user_agreement.evidence: RECONSTRUCTED from empowerment_boundary.md (consent never fades; preserved_user_decision set) and the sparring core's set_intensity_profile
